programme.title: Danny's Dead And Who's Got The Will?
programme.desc: Fran goes to her former fiance Danny's funeral, and fearing she may end up alone, she pushes Maxwell for a commitment.

programme.title: Kissing Cousins
programme.desc: Fran's finds the perfect new boyfriend, only to discover that he's also her cousin.

programme.title: The Fifth Wheel
programme.desc: At the advice of her therapist, Fran is determined to rid her life of men.

programme.title: Samson, He Denied Her
programme.desc: Fran joins C.C. on the jury of a controversial case.

programme.title: The Nose Knows
programme.desc: Maxwell suspects Fran's therapist is pushing her into an affair.

programme.title: The Bank Robbery
programme.desc: Fran and Sylvia are taken hostage in a Valentine's Day bank robbery.

programme.title: The Facts Of Life
programme.desc: Fran suspects Niles if being a killer.

programme.title: Fran's Roots
programme.desc: Fran discovers she may have been switched at birth with the daughter of wealthy parents.

programme.title: The Nanny And The Hunk Producer
programme.desc: A tabloid starts to publish fake stories about Maxwell and Fran having an affair when Maxwell was still married.

programme.title: The Passed Over Story
programme.desc: An successful high school classmate of Fran's tempts Maggie with a job offer.

programme.title: No Muse Is Good Muse
programme.desc: Fran convince a rock star to let her be her muse.

programme.title: You Bette Your Life
programme.desc: Fran offers her services for a charity auction presided over by Bette Midler.

programme.title: Fran's Gotta Have It
programme.desc: Fran's attempt to cement her relationship with Maxwell is rudely interrupted when Niles has a heart attack.

programme.title: The Boca Story
programme.desc: Fran is upset after learning her mother is planning to move to Florida.

programme.title: The Heather Biblow Story
programme.desc: Fran's old nemesis lands a role on a popular soap opera.

programme.title: The Morning After
programme.desc: Worried that Maxwell is going to abandon her, Fran seeks advice from her cousin Sheila.

programme.title: First Date
programme.desc: Maxwell invites Fran to an exclusive dinner with singer Elton John.

programme.title: The Bobbi Fleckman Story
programme.desc: Fran is led to believe that a female record company executive is after Maxwell.

programme.title: A Decent Proposal
programme.desc: Fran's date with comedian Chevy Chase makes Maxwell jealous.

programme.title: Fransom
programme.desc: Fran takes a job walking C.C.'s dog, only to have it kidnapped.

programme.title: Danny's Dead And Who's Got The Will?
programme.desc: Fran goes to her former fiance Danny's funeral, and fearing she may end up alone, she pushes Maxwell for a commitment.

programme.title: The Wood Pile
programme.desc: Joy gives Eddie an ultimatum - build something while she's at work or get rid of the woodpile that he's spent the last twenty years putting together in their garage.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: Eddie is backed into a corner when Joy reminds him of his promise to buy her a diamond engagement ring twenty years ago.

programme.title: Your Mother Or Your Wife
programme.desc: A visit by Jeff's mom exposes Eddie's long-kept secret relationship with his own mother.

programme.title: Death Sex
programme.desc: When their worries over the fact that he might be dying lead Joy to want to have sex more often, Eddie doesn't want to break the spell after learning that he isn't really sick.

programme.title: The Toaster
programme.desc: As Eddie and Joy square off over whether unplugging their toaster will save electricity, Jeff plans to throw a surprise birthday party for Steph.

programme.title: The Garage Band
programme.desc: When Jeff starts feeling suffocated by his marriage, Eddie suggests doing what he does: find something he can do without his wife, like his fake garage band.

programme.title: Dream Getaway
programme.desc: After being virtually forced to spend a weekend with Joy and the Woodcocks at a mountain resort, Eddie is a changed man after learning that Steph dreamed about having sex with him.

programme.title: The Anniversary Party
programme.desc: A friend's 25th wedding anniversary party has Joy wondering why Eddie hasn't taken better care of her, while Jeff is forced to admit that he is embarrassed by Steph's sexually suggestive dance moves.

programme.title: Cruising Angels
programme.desc: Bosley and the Angels are set to transfer Charlie's 100-foot yacht, The Wayward Angel, to Miami -- only to find it stolen and mysteriously returned.

programme.title: Of Ghosts And Angels
programme.desc: While visiting Erica Renny Burke, Tiffany's old college friend, the Angels are alerted to mysterious and sinister occurrences in the Burke mansion.

programme.title: Angel's Child
programme.desc: While working on a robbery case, Kelly calls for police assistance when she observes the thieves escaping. A shootout occurs and one of the thieves, Joe Willow, escapes after killing a cop. Sgt. Cates takes his anger and frustration home where he batters his son, Greg. When Kelly realizes that Cates beats his son, she confronts the Sgt. and presses for child abuse charges. Joe Willow's underworld friends, Stone and Burke, observe the welfare court case awarding Kelly temporary custody of Greg while Cates works on the murder case. The thugs kidnap Kelly and Greg and attempt to persuade Cates to drop the search for Willow. Kelly manipulates her telephone answering service to alert the Angels and Cates to her house where she is being held captive. In the ensuing shootout, Kelly and Greg escape and the Angels apprehend the thugs and Willow. Cates admits his problem and is reunited with his son.

programme.title: One Of Our Angels Is Missing
programme.desc: Bondsman Harry Silvers hires the Angels to locate accused jewel thief Ray Devlin, who has fled, jumping bail. Using a cover as a wealthy divorcee, Kris is to lure Devlin from an Arizona resort back to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Catch A Falling Angel
programme.desc: Tennessean Seth Jeffers follows his girlfriend, Bess Murdock, to Los Angeles and discovers she is acting in porno movies. But when Seth disappears, the Angels are called to investigate. Kelly discovers a showbill with Bess' picture and the producer's name, Joe Willis. Kris approaches Willis and the Angels find and question Bess, who knows nothing about Seth's disappearance. Willis orders the Angels killed and they barely escape death in an auto accident. Kris steals a copy of Willis' movie and upon recognizing the locale, she has police comb the area for Jeffers' body. Bess overhears Willis tell his thugs how to handle police questions about Jeffers. She confronts him, but cannot escape Joe's plans to photograph her own death on film. Kris arrives in time to interrupt the shooting and following a brief shootout, the Angels arrive to apprehend the whole crew. A shaken Bess recuperates and returns home to Tennessee.

programme.title: Homes, Sweet Homes
programme.desc: When a wealthy Beverly Hills couple is robbed of valuable Egyptian art treasures, the Angels suspect the dapper real estate baron, Barry Kingsbrook. Kris infiltrates the Kingsbrook Agency as an agent and the Angels set up a phony house listing to lure Barry to Tiffany's supposed priceless collection of revolutionary period letters. Barry sets a deal with Bosley who poses as a wealthy collector willing to buy letters. Barry's assistant, Tina, tells him that Kris is a plant and while Tina shows Tiffany's house to prospective buyers (including the thieves) Barry takes Kris to his house where he attempts to drug her drink. The Angels capture the thieves and persuade Tina to tell where Kris is located. As the Angels arrive at Barry's house, they find that Kris has beaten Barry into confessing his role in previous thefts for money used to pay his enormous gambling debts.

programme.title: School Days, School Daze
programme.desc: Tabitha gets an assist from her grandmother when Endora casts a spell that turns her into a 7year-old super genius.

programme.title: A Good Turn Never Goes Unpunished
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin argue over the use of witchcraft in an ad campaign.

programme.title: Samantha's Witchcraft Blows A Fuse
programme.desc: Old Chines proverb: Witch should blink softly and never touch cinnamon stick.

programme.title: The Truth, Nothing But The Truth, So Help Me Sam
programme.desc: Endora casts a truth spell on a gift from Darrin to Samantha that causes everyone embarrassment.

programme.title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: Be It Ever So Mortgaged
programme.desc: Endora is disgusted when Samantha refuses to use supernatural powers to cope with the routine tasks of a suburban housewife.

programme.title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Mother Meet What's His Name
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Help, Help, Don't Save Me
programme.desc: Darrin struggles for days to create an advertising campaign for Caldwell Soup. Samantha's suggestions seem perfect, but Darrin's pride leads him to suspect Witchcraft. Stubborn, Darrin presents his own ideas to Phillip Caldwell, who rejects them. Samantha, worn out with housework, is stung when Darrin accuses her of using witchcraft to do that too. Endora, Samantha's mother, who dislikes Darrin, is pleased when the couple quarrels, and Samantha, packing in her own curious fashion, walks out. Crushed at losing his wife and a client in one week, Darrin submits Samantha's ideas to Larry Tate, his boss, who thinks they are great. Tate is bewildered when Darrin ecstatically accepts Caldwell's rejection and dashes home to make up with Samantha. Darrin then uses Samantha's chance remark as the basin for a successful Caldwell Soup campaign, blissfully unaware that Samantha planned it just that way.

programme.title: Little Pitchers Have Big Fears
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: The Witches Are Out
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: The Girl Reporter
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin Monster Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Witch Or Wife
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Just One Happy Family
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a Miss Jasmine for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is Miss Jasmine. Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the Miss Jasmine campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of Miss Jasmine into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: ...And Something Makes Three
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

programme.title: School Days, School Daze
programme.desc: Tabitha gets an assist from her grandmother when Endora casts a spell that turns her into a 7year-old super genius.

programme.title: A Good Turn Never Goes Unpunished
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin argue over the use of witchcraft in an ad campaign.

programme.title: Samantha's Witchcraft Blows A Fuse
programme.desc: Old Chines proverb: Witch should blink softly and never touch cinnamon stick.

programme.title: The Truth, Nothing But The Truth, So Help Me Sam
programme.desc: Endora casts a truth spell on a gift from Darrin to Samantha that causes everyone embarrassment.

programme.title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: Be It Ever So Mortgaged
programme.desc: Endora is disgusted when Samantha refuses to use supernatural powers to cope with the routine tasks of a suburban housewife.

programme.title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Mother Meet What's His Name
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Help, Help, Don't Save Me
programme.desc: Darrin struggles for days to create an advertising campaign for Caldwell Soup. Samantha's suggestions seem perfect, but Darrin's pride leads him to suspect Witchcraft. Stubborn, Darrin presents his own ideas to Phillip Caldwell, who rejects them. Samantha, worn out with housework, is stung when Darrin accuses her of using witchcraft to do that too. Endora, Samantha's mother, who dislikes Darrin, is pleased when the couple quarrels, and Samantha, packing in her own curious fashion, walks out. Crushed at losing his wife and a client in one week, Darrin submits Samantha's ideas to Larry Tate, his boss, who thinks they are great. Tate is bewildered when Darrin ecstatically accepts Caldwell's rejection and dashes home to make up with Samantha. Darrin then uses Samantha's chance remark as the basin for a successful Caldwell Soup campaign, blissfully unaware that Samantha planned it just that way.

programme.title: Little Pitchers Have Big Fears
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: The Witches Are Out
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: The Girl Reporter
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin Monster Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Witch Or Wife
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Just One Happy Family
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a Miss Jasmine for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is Miss Jasmine. Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the Miss Jasmine campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of Miss Jasmine into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Too Many Tonys
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: The Richest Astronaut In The Whole Wide World
programme.desc: Roger discovers the secret of Jeannie's existence when he accidentally releases her from her bottle.

programme.title: Is There An Extra Jeannie In The House?
programme.desc: Roger keeps Sheila, Dr. Bellows' niece, out long past her uncle's curfew.

programme.title: Never Try To Outsmart A Genie
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie the government is sending him to Rome.

programme.title: My Master The Doctor
programme.desc: Roger is to have an operation. After telling Jeannie he always wanted to be a surgeon, Tony finds himself masked and gowned in the operating room.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Kidnap Caper
programme.desc: Tony insists that Jeannie stop waiting on him. Jeannie takes the sacred oath of the genies to refuse any further request for help he might make.

programme.title: How Lucky Can You Get?
programme.desc: Tony and Roger decide to go to Reno. Roger's vision of becoming a multimillionaire with Jeannie's help disappears when Tony tells him Jeannie is not going with them.

programme.title: Watch The Birdie
programme.desc: Tony, accompanied by Jeannie, goes to the golf course to deliver some documents to General Peterson.

programme.title: The Permanent House Guest
programme.desc: Jeannie is disappointed that Tony has never asked for anything big, like a yacht.

programme.title: Bigger Than A Bread Box And Better Than A Genie
programme.desc: Madam Zolta, a fortuneteller, impresses Roger with her knowledge of his past.

programme.title: My Master, The Great Rembrandt
programme.desc: The astronauts paint pictures to be auctioned off at the Air Force Benefit Show.

programme.title: My Master, The Thief
programme.desc: Nostalgia grips Jeannie when she learns the local museum is showing an exhibit from Bukistan, her old home.

programme.title: This Is Murder
programme.desc: Tony is assigned to assure Princess Tarji a good time during her three-day visit to the country, since the US is anxious to make a deal for oil with her father, the Shah of Pakuait.

programme.title: My Master, The Magician
programme.desc: Jeannie brings dinner to Tony's office. Overhearing Tony and Jeannie late at night, Dr. Bellows tells General Peterson Tony is having an orgy.

programme.title: I'll Never Forget What's Her Name
programme.desc: Tony receives a letter asking him to escort Miss Gordon around Cocoa Beach.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Nuorenparin täytyy paeta lähetyssaarnaaja-asemaltaan Kalaharin autiomaassa, kun sotilaallinen äärijärjestö uhkaa heitä. Mutta kun heidän koneensa tippuu villieläinten suojelualueelle, heidän täytyy taistella henkensä edestä.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: He tappoivat hänen ystävänsä ja vaimonsa. He uhkasivat tappaa kaikki hänen tulevat tuttavansa. Kun vapaaottelija Luke Wright itsemurhan partaalla näkee samojen venäläisten mafiatyyppien jahtaavan 12-vuotiasta kiinalaista tyttöä, hänellä naksahtaa.

programme.title: Reunalla
programme.desc: Uskallatko ottaa seuraavan askeleen? Vankikarkuri Nick Cassidy ilmestyy yhtäkkiä pilvenpiirtäjän reunukselle New Yorkissa. Aikooko hän hypätä?

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja onnea
programme.desc: Tavanomaista Spencer - Hill -mättöä. Matt Kirby ja Wilbur Walsh (Hill And Spencer) ovat hieman aggressiivisia luonteita ja joutuvatkin usein vaikeuksiin, joista kuitenkin yleensä selviytyvät nyrkkiensä avulla.

programme.title: Banaanipojat hula-hula saarella
programme.desc: Huoletonta elämää viettävä onnenonkija Alan saa käsiinsä aarrekartan, josta selviää japanilaisten sotajoukkojen toisen maailmansodan aikana kätkemän rahasaaliin sijainti.

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa!

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banaani Joen elämä on yhtä auringonpaistetta. Lokoisaa iloista oloa, ilman stressiä eteläisellä paratiisisaarella, kunnes... Joen asuinkylä on jäämässä modernin business-kulttuurin jalkoihin. Pian paikkaa pyörittävät byrokraatit ja jengit, pykälineen ja paheineen.

programme.title: Senkka nenästä pojat!
programme.desc: Järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vedonlyöjät, korttihait ja huijarit piinaavat toimillaan Miamia, ja poliisin johto on päättänyt ottaa kovat keinot käyttöön ja puhdistaa kaupungin.

programme.title: Renegades
programme.desc: Renegades kertoo Yhdysvaltain laivaston erikoisjoukosta, joka on komennuksella sodan riivaamassa Itä-Euroopassa.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: Liity tähtitieteen professorin matkaan, kun hän kilpailee aikaa vastaan ​​pelastaakseen perheensä maata kohti suuntautuvalta katastrofaaliselta asteroidilta yrittäen samalla varoittaa maailmaa. Selviytyykö ihmiskunta?

programme.title: Conan The Barbarian
programme.desc: Etsintäretki alkaa henkilökohtaisena verikostona, kun hurja kimmerialaissoturi käy eeppiseen taistoon isoja vihollisia ja kammottavia hirviöitä vastaan, vaikka mahdollisuudet ovat olemattomat. Conan huomaa pian, että vain hän voi pelastaa Hyborian kansat voimistuvan yliluonnollisen pahan vallalta.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond kasvoi New Yorkin timanttikeskuksen takahuoneissa opetellen jalokivialaa pohjalta alkaen. Nyt Moe käyttää yhteyksiään pestäkseen miljoonia dollareita laitonta rahaa.

programme.title: Van Veeteren: Pääsky, kissa, ruusu, kuolema
programme.desc: Van Veeteren –elokuvat perustuvat Håkan Nesserin menestysromaaneihin.

programme.title: Bandidas
programme.desc: 1800-luvun lopun Meksiko on todellinen paheiden pesä, jossa raha sanelee säännöt. Sara on rikkaan pankkiirin tytär, kun taas Maria on köyhä talonpoikaisnainen.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Yritysvakoilun hämärässä valtakunnassa kyllästynyt jokamies kompastuu petoksen verkkoon ja hänestä tulee tietämätön vakooja. Kun hän navigoi petoksessa ja petoksessa, hän tekee yhteistyötä viettelevän arvoituksen kanssa paljastaakseen järkyttäviä totuuksia ja saadakseen takaisin identiteettinsä.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Ahkera lukiolainen Vee Delmonico on kyllästynyt olemaan varjossa. Kun kaverit painostavat osallistumaan suosittuun nettipeliin, Nerveen, Vee päättää osallistua yhteen kisaan harmitonta hupia.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Power Rangers on viiden tavallisen lukiolaisen tarina. He löytävät ikivanhan avaruusaluksen ja huomaavat yhtäkkiä saaneensa yliluonnolliset voimat.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splinter; rotta sensei; aistii, että hänen neljä teini-ikäistä kilpikonnaopettajaansa ovat eronneet ja heidän on luotava side voittaakseen muinaisen hirviön.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Keskiajan historia kirjoitetaan uudelleen, kun Jamal Walker putoaa Medieval World -teemapuiston vallihautaan ja huomaa siirtyneensä ajassa taaksepäin.

programme.title: Gods Of Egypt
programme.desc: Tässä muinaisen Egyptin mytologiasta ammentavassa toimintaseikkailussa koko ihmiskunnan tulevaisuus on vaakalaudalla, kun tavallinen kuolevainen Bek nousee sankariksi ryhtyessään pelastamaan maailmaa ja tosirakkauttaan.

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Lahjakas asianajaja Casey McKay matkustaa ex-vaimonsa kotikaupunkiin puolustamaan tämän veljeä, jota syytetään piirisyyttäjän murhasta. Siellä McKay saa selville salaliiton, joka johtaa hänet avoimeen konfliktiin kaupungin korruptoituneimman rakennuttajan Gatesin kanssa.

programme.title: Ghost Rider - Koston Henki
programme.desc: Johnny Blaze taistelee edelleen kiroustaan vastaan paholaisen palkkionmetsästäjänä. Kun salainen uskonnollinen lahko palkkaa hänet tehtävään, hän ei tunne olevansa valmis käyttämään Ghost Riderin voimiaan ja valtaansa jälleen kerran.

programme.title: Pompeji
programme.desc: Elokuva kertoo eeppisen tarinan Milo-orjasta, joka taistelee gladiaattorina Rooman valtakunnassa. Vesuvius-tulivuori sylkee tuhoisaa laavaansa, ja Milo taistelee aikaa vastaan pelastaakseen Cassian, suuren rakkautensa.

programme.title: Collide
programme.desc: Nuori amerikkalainen reppumatkaaja Casey rakastuu Saksassa amerikkalaiseen Julietteen, joka myös kiertää Eurooppaa. Kun Juliettella todetaan vakava sairaus, Casey päättää varastaa saksalaisgangsteri Hagenilta maksaakseen hoidon, joka voi pelastaa tytön hengen.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Toiminnantäyteisessä sci-fi -trillerissä ryhmä nuoria amerikkalaisia on vierailulla Moskovassa, kun muukalaislaji hyökkää kaupunkiin ja syöksee heidät keskelle epätoivoista selviytymistaistelua.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman. Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun.

programme.title: Otters and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: Tracking the exotic pet trade of otters across the globe, is a story of gangsters and guns, mammals, and middlemen. Japanese otter cafés and social media influencers are driving increased demand for pet otters all over the world, with devastating consequences. These otters might be adorable, but the truth behind this trade is anything but. Ripped from the wild or irresponsibly bred, orphaned by poachers and confined in unnatural environments, these otters live a life of extreme misery. Following World Animal Protection intelligence, environmental photojournalist Aaron Gekoski investigates Otters and the Exotic Pet Trade.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji manages to defeat Reira, continuing on to fight Leo. Elsewhere, Yuri absorbs Yugo and aims to defeat Yuya so that Zarc can be completed. Yusho stands in for his son to fight the depraved youth instead.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho's advanced Dueltaining manages to push Yuri into a corner and bring Yuya back to his old self. But Yuri is determined to complete Zarc's revival and has one nasty surprise in store for Yusho.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Seeing his father carded in front of his eyes, Yuya's rage reaches a boiling point as he accepts Yuri's challenge. But not only does he have to contend with Yugo and Yuri's dragons, but Zarc's ever growing influence over him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions start to fuse together as Yuya continues to struggle against Yuri. Forced to discard his trump card, things seem hopeless. Yuya's friends then arrive to encourage him to keep fighting no matter what.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Vector sets his sights on squashing Marin and Dumon, and there’s nothing Shark can do but watch his sister and best friend squirm before his eyes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The thunderous battle between Marin, Dumon and Vector shatters expectations as it nears its startling end! Meanwhile, Alito stands tall against his former friend, the Barian behemoth - Girag!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Marin's duel with Vector charges to its climactic conclusion! Can Marin outduel this venomous villain, or will Vector remain invincible?!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The long foreshadowed faceoff is finally here! Kite and Mizar go toe-to-toe to settle who is the one true Galaxy-Eyes master!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The fierce face-off between Kite and Mizar soars to new heights as their battle to determine the one true Galaxy-Eyes master roars to a finish!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Even with the potent power of Obelisk the Tormentor, the Pharaoh couldn’t prevent the bandit Bakura from escaping!

programme.desc: Mahad, the first of the Pharaoh’s guardians, has fallen!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Atem – more than friends, closer than brothers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Within Satellite, a location segregated from a luxurious utopia, New Domino City; lies Yusei Fudo, a young duelist and Duel Runner enthusiast who is plotting revenge against his rival and former friend, Jack Atlas, the current King of New Domino City in an attempt to reclaim his stolen Duel Runner and Stardust Dragon card. However, Yusei must first deal with Sector Security as they attempt to arrest his friend Rally Dawson for stealing a Duel Runner piece for Yusei's Duel Runner.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei reminisces about the past whilst developing his Duel Runner in preparation for sneaking into New Domino City and reclaiming what was stolen from him. In the meantime, Blitz, Nervin and Tank become involved in a fight with Lenny, Lug and Larry who then turn up at Yusei's hideout and demand his Duel Runner. To protect his friends and their bonds, Yusei duels Lenny with his Duel Runner on the line.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The time has finally arrived for Yusei to sneak into New Domino City so he can settle the score with Jack and reclaim what was stolen from him. However, Tetsu Trudge interrupts Yusei's plan and uses the imposed Speed World to force Yusei into a Turbo Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei finally manages to meet Jack in New Domino. Here, they hold a Turbo Duel with Yusei's Stardust Dragon on the line. Yusei is determine to have his card back and get his revenge on his former friend.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei continues his Turbo Duel with Jack after Jack has managed to Summon both their aces Red Dragon Archfiend and Stardust Dragon. Yusei is able to gain control of Stardust Dragon with Harmonia Mirror. But unknown to them, the summoning of the two dragons trigger an event that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo has been caught by the Sector Security and sent to the Facility. In the paddy wagon, he meets a man called Tenzen Yanagi whom he befriends. The former Pro Duelist, Bolt Tanner, meets Yusei there. Tanner challenges Yusei, who is unable to Duel since he doesn't have a Deck. As a result, Yanagi Duels in his place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Disgusted by Tanner speaking ill of Yanagi's cards and stomping on them, Yusei Duels Tanner using Yanagi's Deck, in order to teach him that no card is truly unneeded (in the dub he wanted to teach him what respect really means).

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Securities examine Yusei's body for confirmation of his Mark of the Dragon. Meanwhile, Jack has learned of the legend of the Crimson Dragon and forces himself to obey Goodwin and hosts a Turbo Duel between him and Hunter Pace, who wants a rematch with him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Mr. Armstrong harasses Yusei's friends in front of him and Yusei duels Armstrong with his freedom and the safety of his friends on the line. Armstrong has seized all of Yusei's Decks so Yusei duels him using cards given to him from his friends at the Facility.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei continues his Duel with Mr. Armstrong, using cards given to him by inmates at the Facility. Despite Armstrong's brutal attack, Yusei refuses to abandon his friends and lose his freedom.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: In order to get back his Deck and Duel Runner, Yusei meets a man named Blister, but he is soon pursued by Trudge, who still wants to get his revenge on Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei, who got back his Duel Runner and his Deck, continued his Turbo Duel with Trudge. Blister, who is witnessing the Turbo Duel, does not understand why Yusei is so determined to retrieve his Bonds of Friendship.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo is left unconscious after his harsh Duel with Trudge. The twins Leo and Luna rescue him. After Yusei regains consciousness, Leo demands a Duel with him. Meanwhile, Trudge waits outside in the hopes of capturing Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo decides to enter the Fortune Cup, after Lazar blackmailed him to do so, if he wants to see his friends at Satellite alive. On his way, he meets up with his old friends from the Facility, Bolt Tanner and Yanagi and his new friend, Leo at the Daimon Area. Leo and his friend Dexter went to the Daimon Area in order to challenge the mysterious Black Rose.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Fortune Cup has now begun. The first Duel is Luna vs. Greiger. But since Luna doesn't want to participate, Leo disguises himself and Duels in her place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Luna and Dexter try to cheer up Leo after his loss to Greiger. They approach Yusei, who tells him the experience he got from losing should prove useful later on. Leo encourages Yusei to win, just before Akiza passes them. She glares intensely at Yusei as she passes. The other three quickly step out of her way. Leo wonders what her problem is.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Hunter Pace, under the disguise of Shira, Duels Yusei Fudo in the Fortune Cup, using a Deck he's designed to use against Jack Atlas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Due to Rex Goodwin's special permission, a consolation game is to be held. Luna is called to participate. Leo is unable to substitute and Luna reluctantly comes forward. Her opponent, Professor Frank, has a trip to the Duel Monsters Spirit World planned.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Luna engages in her Duel with Professor Frank when she is called by a mysterious voice to protect the Duel Monsters Spirit World Seeing the turmoil evildoers are doing to this land, Luna must take all her courage and skill at hand to defeat Frank's trump card.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The first day of the Fortune Cup comes to a close. Before their Duel begins tomorrow, Yusei and Greiger have a friendly talk during the night.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Determined to carry out his mission to his hometown, Greiger uses Flying Fortress SKY FIRE to run Yusei down. In response, Yusei reads Greiger's strategy and looks for his chance to counterattack.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya absorbs all of his counterparts and reclaimed his true form as Supreme King Z-ARC. Starting to lay waste to the Fusion Dimension, Sora and Edo challenge Zarc to try and reach out to Yuya's spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions continue to unite as Zarc effortlessly crushes Sora and Edo. Kaito and Shun continue the fight against Zarc while people from Heartland and Neo Domino City start appearing in the Fusion Dimension.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Jack fight against Zarc next, trying their best to reach out to Yuya's soul buried in Zarc's darkness. A revived Crow and Sawatari decide to join in when Zarc's Supreme King Dragons swarm the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Crow notices that Zarc is starting to lose his composure, leading him and Sawatari to up their game against Zarc's dragons. As dimensional integration is getting closer to completion, Reiji tries to convince his dad to stop Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Ray's soul possesses Reira so she can battle against Zarc alongside Reiji. Zarc boasts that he is the creator of Pendulum Summon, but Ray is determined to stop him once and for all using the four natural energy cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Nash races to face Vector, but with Vector's enhanced strength, he may be speeding towards his own demise!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While Nash and Vector's danger-fueled duel hits dizzying new heights of havoc, the truth behind Vector’s dark past is revealed!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma teams up with an unlikely ally to take down the great Barian deity, Don Thousand! Can this twosome draw out a victory, or will Don Thousand douse any hope these heroes have of being victorious?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma and Shark’s battle with Don Thousand takes a treacherous turn when the great Barian deity reveals he can rewrite their cards into entirely different cards! Can Yuma and Shark defeat a foe who can change their every move?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma and Shark turn the tides and put Don Thousand on the brink of defeat, but DonThousand still has a thousand tricks up his sleeve!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The second round of the finals pits Akiza Izinski against Commander Koda. Koda begins his strategy of tormenting Akiza with her record of the past 16 years, in which flashbacks of Akiza's life are shown.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo confronts and questions Akiza Izinski on why she calls the Mark of the Dragon a wretched mark. During the Duel against her, Yusei is filled with various doubts about Akiza.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei Fudo and Akiza Izinski continues. Unconvinced that Akiza truly takes pleasure in bringing pain on others, he tries to reach through to her and get her to admit this and realize that she can think for herself.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei Fudo and Jack Atlas in the Fortune Cup can begin. During the Duel, Jack remembers what drove him to go to New Domino City with Yusei's old Duel Runner and the Stardust Dragon card in the first place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei Fudo and Jack Atlas heats up. Even though the Signers are transported into the past that is related to the Crimson Dragon, Jack is still determined to win the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei, winner of the Fortune Cup and the appearance of the Crimson Dragon, catches the interest of the media and the mysterious organization, called the Dark Signers. One of these Dark Signers challenges Yusei to a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo continues his Duel with the man with the spider mark. His opponent reveals himself to be a Dark Signer. The reporter Carly Carmine tries to get a scoop as she watches the Duel. Meanwhile the other Dark Signers influence people to stand with them in their fight against the Crimson Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: After his Duel with Grady, Yusei is willingly arrested by Trudge and Sector Security. Meanwhile, Carly, disguised as a nurse, tries to interview Jack at the hospital. Possessed by the Spider mark, Trudge appears and challenges Jack and Carly to a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Crow steals a number of Decks at a Security warehouse and plans his escape on a Duel Runner. Meanwhile, Goodwin tells Yusei about the Dark Signers, and Mina and Trudge look into Jack's disappearance.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei has managed to reunite with his friend Crow Hogan, who tells him about some disturbance coming from the inner part of Satellite. Meanwhile, Jack Atlas and Carly Carmine spend the day at an amusement park, unaware that they are being followed by Mina and Trudge.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei, Crow, Rally and the others meet together at Daedalus Bridge, Crow's hideout and Crow tells them the story of the legendary man of Daedalus Bridge. Meanwhile, in town, a baffling incident involving the Nazca Lines disappearing has occurred. Yusei sets his eyes on the backwoods of Satellite, the B.A.D. Area, so he can come face-to-face with a Dark Signer, namely Kalin Kessler, who seems to know Yusei very well.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: My Journey to You
programme.desc: Two people with different opinions on marriage and love, One person carries the scars of a past love, the other is being careful about making impulsive romantic decisions. Amruta has unwavering faith in relationships, while Virat, on the other hand, has reservations about love, Can they find their way into each other's hearts?

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.desc: Kausi 1, Jakso 2. Planeettamme syntyi kosmisessa myrskyssä ja muokkaantui meteoriitti sateessa. Olemme täällä vaarallisessa kosmoksessa tapahtuneiden sattumusten takia.

programme.title: Historialliset katastrofit
programme.desc: Kausi 2, Jakso 3. Tutustu historian kymmeneen dramaattisimpaan rakenteelliseen romahdukseen, kuten kävelysiltatuho Morbissa vuonna 2022 sekä tuhoisa rakennuksen romahtaminen Bangladeshin Savarissa vuonna 2013. Nämä tapahtumat korostavat rakenteellisten vikojen tuhoisia seurauksia, jotka vaikuttavat tuhansiin ihmishenkiin, häiritsevät taloutta ja jättävät pysyviä arpia tragedioiden koettelemiin yhteisöihin.

programme.title: Historialliset katastrofit
programme.desc: Kausi 2, Jakso 4. Kun pato romahtaa, katastrofi voi olla yhtä paha kuin tsunami. Patojen romahdukset tuhoavat yhteisöjä ja vievät mennessään kaiken tieltään. Selvitä, mikä laukaisi nämä tapahtumat, miten ne olisi voitu estää, ja mitä oppeja niistä on saatu. Tässä jaksossa paljastetaan historian dramaattisimmat patovauriot muun muassa Yhdysvalloista, Laosista, Brasiliasta sekä Italiasta.

programme.title: Huutokaupan metsästäjät
programme.desc: Kausi 14, Jakso 27. Brandi on liekeissä laajentaessaan brändiään San Bernadinoon. Rene on vakuuttunut, että kaikki yrittävät kampittaa häntä. Dustyn varasto on pölysempi kuin hän itse ja Kenny on itsessään sekasotku.

programme.title: Huutokaupan metsästäjät
programme.desc: Kausi 14, Jakso 28. Lisa joutuu nostalgian valtaan palatessaan Moreno Valleyhin, josta kaikki alkoi. Kenny toivottaa uuden lapsenlapsen tervetulleeksi klaaniin ja toivoo löytävänsä sopivan varaston.

programme.title: Egyptin kadonneet aarteet
programme.desc: Kausi 5, Jakso 10. Arkeologit tutkivat kätkettyjä hautoja ja kadonneita temppeleitä selvittääkseen, miten Tutankhamon muutti muinaisten egyptiläisten tapaa palvoa jumaliaan. Dra' Abu El-Naga'ssa kolmen arkun löytö johtaa valtavaan, haudattuun hautakammioon. Hermopolis Magnan kauan sitten unohdetussa temppelissä ryhmä löytää todisteita muinaisesta, kielletystä uskonnosta.

programme.title: Lentoturmatutkinta
programme.desc: Kausi 24, Jakso 10. Jälkiasennuksen jälkeen kolme Airborne Express -lentäjää nousee muunneltuun DC-8-rahtikoneeseen rutiinitestilentoa varten, joka päättyy katastrofiin. Hylky kertoo tutkijoille, että kone törmäsi Virginiassa vuorenrinteeseen yhtenä kappaleena. Kun he selvittävät, mikä meni pieleen, he paljastavat katastrofaalisen virhesarjan, joka tuomitsi koneen tuhoon jo ennen kuin se nousi maasta.

programme.title: Pohjoisen valtatien pelastajat
programme.desc: Kausi 11, Jakso 3. Thord on juuri siirtämässä päätiellä poikittain olevaa rekkaa, kun hän saa tiedon vakavasta nokkakolarista. Hänen on saatava rekka pois tieltä kiireen vilkkaa ennen kuin hän voi rientää toiselle onnettomuuspaikalle. Samaan aikaan Jo Roger pelastaa pienen puron yläpuolelle kaatunutta kaivinkonetta. Öljyvuodon riski tarkoittaa, ettei virheisiin ole varaa.

programme.title: Maailmansodan kadonneet laivat
programme.desc: Kausi 1, Jakso 1. Vain viikkoja ennen toisen maailmansodan päättymistä USS Indianapolis upposi rajusti, ja 900 merimiestä jäi merelle ilman pelastusta. Viiden päivän ajan he taistelivat merta, auringon säteilyä ja haiden hyökkäyksiä vastaan Yhdysvaltain merivoimien historian pahimmassa merionnettomuudessa.

programme.title: Maailmansodan kadonneet laivat
programme.desc: Kausi 1, Jakso 2. Petrel-tutkimusaluksen vedenalaiset tutkijat havaitsevat Filippiinien rannikolla hylyn, joka sopii amerikkalaisen hävittäjän profiiliin. Voisiko kyseessä olla USS Ward, joka ampui Amerikan ensimmäisen laukauksen toisessa maailmansodassa Pearl Harborissa?

programme.title: Inkojen nousu ja tuho
programme.desc: Kausi 1, Jakso 1. Inka-imperiumin alkuperä säilyi vuosisatoja mysteerinä. Seuraa Manco Capacia, ensimmäistä inkaa, sekä Pachacutecia, keisaria, joka mullisti sivilisaation, rakensi Machu Picchun ja laajensi valtakunnan Cuzcon laakson ulkopuolelle. Keisari julisti aurinkokultin valtionuskonnoksi ja uhrasi ihmisuhreja valtansa vahvistukseksi. Uusin tiede ja 3D-rekonstruktiot paljastavat Auringon valtakunnan syntymän.

programme.title: Hitlerin viimeinen taistelu
programme.desc: Kausi 6, Jakso 4. Yhdysvaltojen lääkintämiehet eivät kykene pelastamaan seitsemää haavoittunutta sotilasta rankan tulituksen vuoksi, joten aliupseeri Stephen Gregg ottaa . 30 kaliiperin konekiväärin ja etenee ampuen ase lantiollaan ja suojaa heitä. Kun lääkintämiehet ovat saaneet vedettyä viimeisen uhrin turvaan, Greggin ammukset loppuvat ja saksalaissotilaat vangitsevat hänet. Hänen täytyy löytää pakokeino.

programme.desc: Kausi 1, Jakso 1. Fajardossa agentit jahtaavat alusta venesatamaan, jossa epäillyt pakenevat ja jättävät alukseen yli 280 kiloa kokaiinia. Mayagüezin aseistetut agentit kuljettavat USCG:n murhaepäillyn mereltä lentokentälle. Myöhemmin he pysäyttävät siirtolaisaluksen ampumalla moottorin. Yhdysvaltain Neitsytsaarilla agentit takavarikoivat yli 750 000 dollaria käteistä salakuljetusalukselta.

programme.desc: Kausi 1, Jakso 5. Joe Crowley ja Suzannah Lipscomb tutkivat koston tarinoita. Kuka tappoi Mussolinin ja kuinka Napoleonia vastaan kohdistetut hyökkäykset vaikuttivat hänen poliittiseen uraan? National Geographic Channel.

programme.title: Autojen ensiapu
programme.desc: Kausi 9, Jakso 6. Tim ja Fuzz suuntaavat Lincolnshireen, jossa heitä odottaa kaikkien luksusautojen äiti eli vuoden 1929 Rolls Royce Doctor’s Coupe. Sen kauneuden palauttaminen oli Emilyn isän unelmaprojekti. Hänen kuolemansa jälkeen projekti jäi Emilyltä kesken, joten auto päätyi ruostumaan tallissa. Nyt Autojen ensiavun miehet tulevat palauttamaan tämän luksusauton loistoonsa.

Henkilökunta yrittää selvitä arjesta, kun mitään suunnitelmallisuutta tai tavoitteita ei ole, tai ainakaan henkilökunta ei ole niistä tietoinen. Kotimainen realityohjelma.

programme.title: Eine Reise in den Südosten Portugals

Die Filmautorin Katja Devaux besucht die geschichtsträchtigen alten Städtchen Évora und Monsaraz, entdeckt geheimnisvolle Megalithkreise zwischen riesigen Korkeichen und befährt den größten Stausee Europas an der Grenze zu Spanien. Zweihundert Kilometer südlich trifft Portugal dann auf den Atlantik. Die Algarveküste gehört zu den beliebtesten Zielen für sonnenhungrige Touristen. Ihr Ostteil allerdings ist noch immer ein Geheimtipp.

programme.title: Unkraut
programme.desc: Ein unscheinbarer Bach bei Landshut, dicht gesäumt von Brennnesseln: Hier beginnt die Spurensuche von Arnie. Der Berger de Picardie ist kein gewöhnlicher Hund, sondern ein ausgebildeter Artenspürhund. Gemeinsam mit seiner Besitzerin, der Biologin Irene Wagensonner, soll er eine Aufgabe lösen, an der Menschen schnell an ihre Grenzen kommen: Das Aufspüren streng geschützter, fast unsichtbarer Tierarten. An diesem Tag jagt Arnie dem Geruch einer vom Aussterben bedrohten Art nach - der Bachmuschel. Niemand weiß, ob es in dem Bach noch welche gibt. Ohne Arnie müsste die Biologin den Bach mühsam Meter für Meter absuchen - mit dem Risiko, die empfindlichen Tiere zu übersehen oder versehentlich zu zertreten. Artenspürhunde wie Arnie eröffnen dem Artenschutz neue Möglichkeiten. Sie können Käfer finden, die nur nachts aktiv sind, ohne diese mit Fallen fangen zu müssen. Sie entdecken versteckt lebende Amphibien oder Reptilien, wie Kreuzottern, die viel im Verborgenen leben. Im Bayerischen Wald testet der Kreuzotterspezialist Paul Hien Arnies Fähigkeiten: Bei kühlem Wetter zeigt sich keine einzige Schlange. Doch Arnie markiert gleich mehrfach Stellen in einem Steinriegel - genau dort, wo Hien im Frühjahr zahlreiche Kreuzottern beobachtet hat. Für ihn ist klar: Der Hund kann Vorkommen belegen, auch wenn kein Tier zu sehen ist. Ein unschätzbarer Vorteil, etwa wenn über Bauprojekte in sensiblen Lebensräumen entschieden wird. Während Arnie bereits routiniert arbeitet, steht seine Tochter Lupa noch am Anfang ihrer Karriere. In sorgfältig aufgebauten Trainings lernt sie zunächst, harmlose Zielgerüche wie Gewürze von sehr ähnlichen Düften zu unterscheiden - und den richtigen Fund durch Hinsetzen anzuzeigen. Trotz jugendlichem Übermut und Kameratechnik, die sie zunächst irritiert, zeigt sie, wie viel Talent in ihr steckt. In etwa einem Jahr wird sie ihren Vater bei Einsätzen im Gelände unterstützen. Arnie und Lupa machen mit ihrer Nase sichtbar, was für uns sonst unsichtbar bliebe. Sie helfen, seltene Arten zu entdecken, bevor sie verschwinden - und zeigen, wie innovative Methoden den Artenschutz entscheidend voranbringen können. Wie genau Arnie und Lupa arbeiten - und welche Entdeckungen sie dabei machen - zeigt die Unkraut Reportage Artenspürhunde - Schnüffeln für den Artenschutz. Übrigens: Die Erlebnisse mit den Artenspürhunden Arnie und Lupa gibt's auch zu hören in der neuen ARD-Podcastreihe Mission Artenvielfalt.

programme.title: Die geheime Macht des Geschmacks (1/2)
programme.desc: Die Körper der ersten Organismen enthielten die gleichen chemischen Elemente wie die salzigen Ur-Ozeane. Doch als die Tiere an Land gingen, fanden sie dort kaum Salz. Um es aufzuspüren, entwickelten sich Salzrezeptoren. Und um Mangelzuständen vorzubeugen, arbeitete die Evolution mit einem Trick: Sie verknüpfte den Geschmack von Nahrung mit einer Belohnung, dem Genuss.

programme.title: Die geheime Macht des Geschmacks (2/2)
programme.desc: Süße und Bitterkeit sind Gegenpole, sie signalisieren Genuss und Gefahr. Tiere haben daher eine angeborene Vorliebe für den leicht verdaulichen Energieträger Zucker und eine Abneigung gegen Bitteres. Gegen gierige Fressfeinde entwickelten die Pflanzen bittere Gifte, die Tiere antworteten mit Bitterrezeptoren. Bitterkeit hat aber auch eine gute Seite ...

programme.title: Erlebnisreisen: Antwerpen
programme.desc: Die flämische Metropole Antwerpen ist berühmt für den jahrhundertealten Stadtkern, das Rubens-Haus und die Liebfrauenkathedrale.

programme.title: Hund und Katze – Haustiere Himmel oder Hölle?
programme.desc: Was Hunde und Katzen in den ersten 16 Lebenswochen erleben, prägt sie für immer. Fehlt die Sozialisierung, reagieren die Tiere oft ängstlich oder aggressiv.

programme.title: WeltWeit: Verbannen, verbieten verzweifeln. Was tun gegen die Social Media-Falle?
programme.desc: Ein Zensurangriff für die FPÖ, ein schwammiges Gesetz für die Grünen - die Rede ist vom Vorschlag der Regierung zum Social-Media-Verbot für unter 14-Jährige.

programme.desc: 10 vor 10 ist eine Informationssendung von Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen (SRF).

programme.title: Die Nordreportage: Leben retten im Verborgenen
programme.desc: Wenn Rita Gretzler und ihr Team einen Fehler machen, kann das für Patienten lebensgefährlich werden. Die Reinigungskräfte der Universitätsmedizin Rostock sorgen dafür, dass OP-Säle, Betten und medizinische Instrumente keimfrei bleiben. Unter Zeitdruck reinigen sie blutverschmierte Operationssäle, bereiten Betten für neue Patienten auf und sorgen dafür, dass benutzte Instrumente wieder sicher eingesetzt werden können. Ihre Arbeit bleibt meist unsichtbar, dabei wäre ohne sie kein Krankenhausbetrieb möglich.

programme.title: Fernweh: Karibik: Trinidad und Tobago
programme.desc: Am J'ouvert in Trinidad feiern kurz nach Mitternacht mehr als zwei Millionen Menschen zwei Tage lang zu peitschenden Rhythmen die größte Party der Welt.

programme.title: Fernweh: Karibik: Martinique, Guadeloupe, Grenada
programme.desc: Die französische Insel Martinique ist ein voll integrierter Teil der EU. Im Landesinnern gibt es sogar einen Canton Suisse - es ist der 27. Kanton der Schweiz.

programme.title: Fernweh: Karibik: Dominica, Montserrat
programme.desc: Dominica ist eine grüne, paradiesische Insel. Dorthin ist die Schweizer Familie Burkard ausgewandert. Ihr Leben dreht sich vor allem um Sport.

programme.title: Fernweh: Karibik: Costa Rica Antille St. Martin
programme.desc: Die Karibikinsel St. Martin ist so groß wie der Schweizer Vierwaldstättersee - circa 145 Quadratkilometer - und zur Hälfte holländisch, zur Hälfte französisch. Deshalb gibt es zwei Währungen.

programme.desc: Die Schweiz braucht sich hinter den exotischen Naturparadiesen dieser Welt nicht zu verstecken. So klein sie auch ist, ihre abwechslungsreiche Natur ist einzigartig und steckt voller Wunder.

programme.desc: Der Westen will die russische Elite durch Sanktionen spalten. Sie soll Präsident Putin vom Kriegskurs abbringen. Dieser Plan geht bisher nicht auf.

programme.title: Sehen statt Hören
programme.desc: In Deutschland hat rund ein Viertel der Bevölkerung hat einen Migrationshintergrund und damit eine andere Kultur. Für eine eigene Kultur braucht es aber nicht unbedingt eine andere Herkunft.

programme.title: Mit dem Herzen sehen
programme.desc: Merlin ist 28 Jahre alt und auf der Suche nach dem einen besonderen Menschen, nach der großen Liebe. Doch Merlin ist blind - und das macht das Kennenlernen zu einer besonderen Herausforderung.

programme.title: 37°Leben
programme.desc: Die preisgekrönte Glaubens-WG geht in die zweite Runde: Sechs junge Menschen, sechs Weltanschauungen, eine WG. Was eint sie diesmal, was trennt sie?

programme.title: Andalusien - Spaniens maurischer Süden
programme.desc: Umgeben vom Atlantischen Ozean und dem Mittelmeer, bildet Andalusien mit dem Felsen von Gibraltar die südlichste Region der Iberischen Halbinsel und des europäischen Festlands.Seine vielfältigen Landschaften, die reiche Kultur und die schönen Städte, in denen lebendige Geschichte und auch noch das alte Handwerk blühen, machen Andalusien zu einem der schönsten Reiseziele Europas.

programme.title: Bulgariens letzte Schmalspurbahn
programme.desc: Durch die Rhodopen, ein abgelegenes Gebirge südlich der bulgarischen Hauptstadt Sofia, führt die höchstgelegene Personenzugstrecke des Balkans und die letzte bulgarische Schmalspurbahn. Auf 2.000 Meter Höhe schlängelt sie sich durch weite Naturräume und den Pirin-Nationalpark. Nur dem Engagement einiger Bewohner der Gegend ist es zu verdanken, dass sie immer noch täglich fährt.

programme.title: Rumäniens älteste Gebirgsbahn
programme.desc: Mitten zwischen zwei der schönsten Nationalparks Rumäniens windet sich eine einzigartige Gebirgsbahn an steilen Abhängen entlang und offenbart die unberührte Natur des Banater Gebirges.

programme.title: Legendäre Zugabenteuer: Der Schweizer Glacier Express
programme.desc: Der Glacier Express verkehrt zwischen St. Moritz und Zermatt. Spektakuläre Aufnahmen der Hochgebirgsstrecke wechseln sich ab mit Einblicken in die Technik dieser Schmalspurbahn.

programme.title: Legendäre Zugabenteuer: Kanadas VIA Rail
programme.desc: Die Strecke von Winnipeg nach Churchill ist eine lebenswichtige Verbindung zu den abgelegenen Gemeinden im hohen Norden Kanadas. Doch Schnee und Eis sind eine ständige Herausforderung.

programme.title: Legendäre Zugabenteuer: Mexikos Copper Canyon Railway
programme.desc: Bis zu 1.800 Meter tief sind die Schluchten im mexikanischen Barranca del Cobre. Die Aussicht vom hier verkehrenden Zug CHEPE ist atemberaubend - und der Streckenerhalt äußerst anspruchsvoll.

programme.title: Legendäre Zugabenteuer: Indiens Darjeeling Himalayan Railway
programme.desc: Im Nordosten Indiens machen sich eine Dampf- und eine Diesellokomotive der Darjeeling Himalayan Railway auf atemberaubende Reise. Besonders der bergige Teil der Strecke ist aufregend.

programme.title: NANO: Artenvielfalt – Wie viele Arten brauchen wir?
programme.desc: Tausende Pflanzen- und Tierarten sterben weltweit jährlich aus – oft unbemerkt. Wie viele Arten brauchen wir für stabile Ökosysteme, und was passiert, wenn es immer weniger werden?

programme.title: Zwingli - Der Reformator
programme.desc: 16. Jahrhundert. Der humanistisch ausgebildete katholische Priester Huldrych Zwingli hat keine Scheu, Missstände in der Kirche anzuprangern. Er fürchtet sich nicht davor, den Mächtigen die Stirn zu bieten. Schon bald wird sich der Einfluss dieses wichtigsten Vertreters der protestantischen Reformation in Zürich und Zeitgenossen Luthers auf die gesamte Deutschschweiz ausdehnen.Regie: Stefan Haupt (Schweiz, 2019)

programme.title: Kurzstrecke mit Pierre M. Krause
programme.desc: Aufeinandertreffen von zwei Content-Schwergewichten: SWR Moderator Pierre M. Krause trifft Comedy-Autorin Marie Lina Smyrek - beide sind sich auf Anhieb sympathisch. Neben sehr großen Löwen und Phallus-Dekor wartet eine herrliche SWR Kurzstrecke, die man sich in jede Wohnung stellen kann.
